龙国篇第四十二章人皇传承（三）
在那幽深莫测的地底，一条通道宛如巨兽张开的无尽喉咙，吞噬着一切光明与声响，向前延伸，直至视野的极限，仿佛要通往世界的另一端，那里是时间与空间遗忘的角落，荒无人烟，唯有寂静与黑暗交织成一张无形的网，笼罩着每一寸空间。
丽莎的脚步声在这空旷中回响，每一步都踏出了坚定与未知，她的身影在微弱的手电筒光芒下拉长，仿佛是这无尽深渊中唯一的活物，与周围的死寂形成了鲜明对比。
她就这样不停地走着，心中既有对未知的恐惧，也有对前方可能存在的奇迹的渴望。汗水沿着她的额头滑落，滴落在冰冷的石板上，瞬间消失无踪，只留下斑驳的痕迹，记录着这段孤独而漫长的旅程。呼吸渐渐变得沉重，但丽莎没有停下，她的眼中闪烁着不屈的光芒，那是对探索未知的执着，也是对内心深处某种呼唤的回应。
就在体力即将耗尽，意志即将崩溃的边缘，一抹不可思议的光芒突然划破了前方的黑暗，那是金色的光，温暖而耀眼，如同晨曦初现，驱散了所有的阴霾与寒冷，丽莎的心脏猛地一跳，仿佛被一股无形的力量牵引，她不由自主地加快了脚步，直到那金光完全占据她的视野，她才终于停下了脚步，站在了奇迹的入口。
她抬头仰望，只见高处，一束金色的光芒从某个未知的裂缝中倾泻而下，如同神祇的恩赐，照亮了这片被遗忘的天地，光芒中，似乎还蕴含着某种神秘的力量，让周围的空气都为之震颤，连呼吸都变得异常清新，丽莎的眼中闪烁着泪光，不是因为疲惫，还是因为这突如其来的希望与美丽，让她感受到了前所未有的震撼与感动。
这一刻，她仿佛置身于另一个世界，一个充满奇迹与可能的世界，她深深地吸了一口气，让自己完全沉浸在这份突如其来的光辉之中，心中涌动着前所未有的勇气与决心，她知道，这金光不仅仅是视觉上的奇迹，更是对她这段孤独旅程的最好奖赏，是引领她走向新世界的明灯。
脚步在古老的石板路上轻轻回响，每一步都似乎在与岁月对话，唤醒着沉睡的记忆，她的目光穿越过斑驳的树影，最终定格在那遥远天际一抹璀璨夺目的金光之上，那金光，不似凡尘之物，它温暖而神秘，仿佛蕴含着无尽的故事与力量，让丽莎的心脏不由自主地剧烈跳动起来。
“这金光……”她低声喃喃，声音里既有疑惑也有难以言喻的激动“为何如此熟悉，像是一种跨越时空的共鸣，又像是我灵魂深处久别重逢的故人，它不仅仅是一道光芒，更像是一封来自远方的信笺，无声却强烈地呼唤着我，引领着我走向某个被遗忘的真相。”
她瞪大了眼睛，再一次将目光投向那道耀眼夺目的金光，就在这时，一阵低沉而威严的声音骤然响起，仿佛从远古时代穿越而来，直击她的心灵深处。
这突如其来的声音如同惊雷一般，瞬间打破了周围的寂静，也让她原本就纷乱如麻的思绪变得愈发汹涌澎湃起来。无数的念头和记忆碎片在她的脑海中飞速交织、碰撞，渐渐地拼凑成了一幅幅模糊不清却又极具震撼力的画面。
这些画面如同电影镜头般在她眼前不断闪现，最终汇聚成了一个高大威猛的身影——一位顶天立地的巨人！他屹立于天地之间，浑身散发着令人无法直视的璀璨金光，仿佛整个世界都因他的存在而黯然失色。
那巨人的面容俊美绝伦，犹如精心雕琢而成的艺术品，每一处线条都恰到好处地展现出一种无与伦比的威严与庄重，但同时又透露出一丝难以言喻的温柔与亲切，他那双深邃如海的眼眸正凝视着丽莎，其中蕴含的力量仿佛能够洞悉世间万物的奥秘。
“后辈之人，如此重地，尔不该私闯！”巨人的话语字字千钧，犹如洪钟大吕一般，在这片神秘而古老的空间里轰然回响。每一个字都仿佛蕴含着无尽的力量，震得周围的空气都微微颤抖起来。他那威严的声音，带着一种不可抗拒的气势，显然是想要将眼前这个名叫丽莎的女子逐出这传承之地。
面对巨人的斥责，丽莎并没有丝毫退缩之意，她抬起头，目光坚定地望着巨人，回应道：“前辈，我来此并无恶意，只是一心想要获取人皇传承，以此来守护这人世的安宁与和平。”
听到“人皇传承”四个字，那巨人不禁皱起了眉头，似乎陷入了沉思之中，过了好一会儿，他才缓缓地再次开口说道：“人皇传承可不是一件简单的事情啊！即便从你身上能够让我感觉到故人的一丝气息，但这最多也只能让你在这传承之地不受其负面影响而已。”
沉默片刻之后，巨人再次开口：“不过，既然你如此执着地要进行人皇传承，那么身为这片传承之地守护者的我，自然也只能遵循主人曾经下达给我的命令，但是在此之前，你必须先成功通过接下来等待着你的三个无比艰难的考验才行。”
随着巨人话音落下，他身后原本平静的空间突然间泛起了一阵奇异的光芒，就像是平静的湖面被投入了一颗石子，激起层层涟漪，紧接着，只见三道巨大的门户宛如从虚空中缓缓浮现而出，每一道门户都散发着令人心悸的气息。
“这三道门，分别对应着人世间最为重要的三样东西——情、财、权。”巨人的目光依次扫过三道门户，缓声说道，“而其中，只有一道门才是能够让你通向生路的生门，至于其他两道，则皆是死门。”
听到这，丽莎深吸一口气，然后毅然迈开步伐朝着前方走去，当她来到距离门户不远处时，脚步却不由自主地停了下来，她的目光紧紧锁定在了那道标注着“情”字的门户之上，久久没有移开视线。

“若是只有一道为生门，我想我一定会毫不犹豫地选择这扇情门，然而，这个‘情’字所蕴含的意义实在太过广泛，它涵盖了亲情、友情以及爱情……究竟哪一种情感才能引领我走向生路呢？”
龙国篇第四十二章人皇传承（三）
正当此刻，一幅画面犹如突如其来的风暴，再次席卷了丽莎的思绪海洋。
十三年前……
“丽莎……丽莎……”
在这午后阳光斑驳的校园小径上，一阵急促而充满期待的低呼划破了周围的宁静，丽莎猛然间回头，那双明亮的眼眸中闪烁着青春的火花，仿佛能照亮周遭每一寸角落。那时的丽莎，正值生命的壮年，浑身上下散发着不容忽视的活力与朝气，正如她身边每一位怀揣梦想的同伴，岁月在流转，但大家的梦想却如同被时间精心雕琢的宝石，历久弥新——考入那传说中的武神局，成为万众瞩目的武神，踏上战场，以一腔热血保家卫国，守护这片土地上的每一寸安宁。
正所谓，男儿可建功立业，女儿亦能独当一面，共撑起那浩瀚苍穹的半壁江山。
“你今天怎么了？神情恍惚的，难道，又被那位严厉的老教授抓去打扫那尘封已久的图书馆了？”卡娜带着几分调侃，几分关心的语气问道，同时轻轻靠了靠丽莎的肩膀，两人的友谊在这一刻显得尤为温暖。
丽莎微微一笑，那笑容里藏着几分无奈，几分释然。她轻轻摆了摆头，发丝在阳光下跳跃，如同金色的涟漪。“是啊，老教授的‘特别关照’总是那么准时，不过……”丽莎的话语突然一顿，眼中闪过一丝难以掩饰的激动，“不过，今天下午4点，有个消息可能会让我们的世界天翻地覆！”
卡娜闻言，眼睛猛地一亮，仿佛捕捉到了什么至关重要的信息。“哦？什么消息？”
丽莎深吸一口气，压低声音，却难掩语气中的激动：“武神局，今天下午4点，会有四位SSS级武神亲临本校！他们此行目的明确，要从我们之中挑选出十二名佼佼者，组成三支小队进行专项培养！那可是SSS级武神啊，传说中能够以一己之力扭转战局的存在！”
卡娜的呼吸不由自主地急促起来，她紧紧握住丽莎的手，两人的心跳在这一刻似乎都同步了。“真的吗？丽莎，这……这简直是梦寐以求的机会！我们，我们真的有可能成为他们中的一员吗？”
丽莎用力点头，眼中闪烁着坚定与希望的光芒“是的，卡娜，只要我们不放弃，梦想总有照进现实的一天，今天下午4点，不仅是我们个人的转折点，也许是我们整个班级，乃至整个学校的荣耀时刻！让我们一起努力，为了那个遥远却又触手可及的梦想，拼了！”
卡娜点了点头斩钉截铁道“正所谓，男儿可建功立业，女儿亦能独当一面，共撑起那浩瀚苍穹的半壁江山”
正当丽莎沉浸在往昔回忆中时，那扇标注着“情”字的门户竟缓缓开启，从那逐渐敞开的门缝里，投射出来一缕温暖且异常熟悉的光芒。
这缕光芒就如同一只轻柔的手，轻轻地抚摸过丽莎的脸庞，瞬间便将她那原本游离于记忆深处的思绪，硬生生地给拉回到了残酷的现实当中。
丽莎瞪大了眼睛，满怀着好奇和期待，紧紧地盯着那扇正在开启的门户，当门户终于彻底敞开之后，呈现在她眼前的竟是一幅光怪陆离、变幻莫测的奇异景象。
在这片如梦如幻的光影之中，她先是看到了自己曾经与挚友门一起并肩战斗的场景：她们手持武器，面对着强大的敌人毫不退缩，相互配合得天衣无缝，每一次攻击都精准无比，每一个动作都流畅自然；紧接着，画面一转，出现了亲人们那一张张温柔慈祥的面容，他们正用饱含深情的目光注视着丽莎，嘴里还不停地发出亲切的呼唤声，似乎在召唤着她回家；然而，这还不是全部，随后映入眼帘的居然还有她邂逅过的那位伴侣，他静静地站在那里，虽然看不清具体的模样，但仅仅只是那个轮廓，就足以让丽莎的心弦为之颤动。
所有这些景象如同梦幻般交织在一起，不断地闪烁变换着色彩与形状，就像是一幅绚丽多彩且神秘莫测的画卷在眼前徐徐展开。
每一道光芒的闪烁都仿佛是在低声诉说着一个不为人知的秘密，它们似乎想要透过这变幻无穷的光影向丽莎传达某种重要的信息。

丽莎静静地凝视着眼前这奇妙的景象，心中渐渐领悟到，真正的“情”并不仅仅局限于外在的形式和表象，那些表面上的浪漫举动、甜言蜜语或许能够带来一时的欢愉，但真正深厚且持久的情感却是深藏在每个人内心最深处的那份最为真挚、最为纯粹的选择，这种情感不受时间和空间的限制，也不会被世俗的眼光所左右，它宛如夜空中最璀璨的星辰，始终闪耀着温暖而坚定的光芒。
就像南国一般，整个国度都沉浸在了权力和贪婪编织而成的巨大罗网之中，人们他们的大脑已经完全被这些欲望所掌控，丧失了基本的理智和判断力。
明明如今大敌当前，那些恐怖而强大的异能兽正虎视眈眈地威胁着这片土地和人民的生存，但他们却并没有将所有的精力和资源集中起来，共同团结一心去对抗这一迫在眉睫的危机。相反，这个国家竟然无时无刻不在对周边的其他国家挑起一些微不足道的事端。
或许是为了争夺一点点领土，又或者只是为了满足某些人的虚荣心和私欲，他们频繁地发动小规模的冲突和摩擦，使得原本就紧张的局势变得愈发错综复杂、难以收拾。这种短视且自私自利的行为不仅无法解决自身面临的真正问题，反而还进一步削弱了自己抵御外敌入侵的能力，甚至连累他国。
丽莎深吸一口气，然后迈动脚步，毅然决然地朝着那扇‘情’门走去。

Dragon Kingdom Chapter 42 The Inheritance of the Human Emperor (3)
In that unfathomable underground, a passage is like the endless throat of a giant beast, swallowing up all light and sound, extending forward to the limit of vision, as if it is leading to the other end of the world. There is the forgotten corner of time and space, desolate, and only silence and darkness interweave into an invisible net, covering every inch of space.
Lisa's footsteps echoed in the emptiness, each step filled with determination and unknownness. Her figure was elongated under the faint light of the flashlight, as if she was the only living thing in this endless abyss, in stark contrast to the deathly silence around her.
She kept walking like this, with both fear of the unknown and desire for the possible miracles ahead. The sweat slid down her forehead and dripped on the cold stone slab, disappearing instantly, leaving only mottled traces, recording this lonely and long journey. Her breathing gradually became heavier, but Lisa did not stop. Her eyes shone with unyielding light, which was her persistence in exploring the unknown and a response to some kind of call deep in her heart.
Just when her physical strength was about to be exhausted and her will was about to collapse, an incredible light suddenly cut through the darkness ahead. It was golden light, warm and dazzling, like the dawn, dispelling all the haze and cold. Lisa's heart jumped suddenly, as if being pulled by an invisible force. She involuntarily accelerated her pace. It was not until the golden light completely occupied her field of vision that she finally stopped and stood at the entrance of the miracle.
She looked up and saw a beam of golden light pouring down from an unknown crack in the sky, like a gift from the gods, illuminating this forgotten world. The light seemed to contain some mysterious power, making the surrounding air tremble, and even her breathing became extremely fresh. Tears shone in Lisa's eyes, not because of exhaustion, but because of this sudden hope and beauty, which made her feel unprecedented shock and emotion.
At this moment, she seemed to be in another world, a world full of miracles and possibilities. She took a deep breath and let herself be completely immersed in this sudden brilliance. Her heart was filled with unprecedented courage and determination. She knew that this golden light was not only a visual miracle, but also the best reward for her lonely journey and the beacon that led her to a new world.
The footsteps echoed softly on the ancient stone road. Every step seemed to be in dialogue with the years, awakening sleeping memories. Her eyes passed through the mottled tree shadows, and finally settled on a dazzling golden light in the distant sky. The golden light was not like ordinary things. It was warm and mysterious, and seemed to contain endless stories and power, making Lisa's heart beat violently involuntarily.
"This golden light..." She murmured in a low voice, with doubts and indescribable excitement in her voice. "Why is it so familiar? It's like a resonance that spans time and space, and it's like an old friend reunited deep in my soul after a long absence. It's not just a ray of light, but more like a letter from afar, calling me silently but strongly, leading me towards a forgotten truth."
Her eyes widened and she once again cast her gaze on the dazzling golden light. At this moment, a low and majestic voice suddenly sounded, as if it had traveled from ancient times and struck directly into the depths of her soul.
This sudden sound was like thunder, instantly breaking the silence around her and making her already chaotic thoughts become more and more turbulent. Countless thoughts and memory fragments intertwined and collided rapidly in her mind, gradually pieced together into vague but shocking pictures.
These images flashed before her eyes like movie shots, eventually converging into a tall and mighty figure - a man who stood tall and indomitable.The giant! He stood between heaven and earth, emitting a brilliant golden light that was impossible to look directly at, as if the whole world was eclipsed by his presence.
The giant's face was extremely handsome, like a carefully carved work of art. Every line showed an unparalleled majesty and solemnity, but at the same time revealed a touch of indescribable tenderness and kindness. His eyes as deep as the sea were staring at Lisa, and the power contained in them seemed to be able to understand the mysteries of all things in the world.
"Younger generation, you shouldn't invade such an important place privately!" The giant's words were as sharp as a bell, resounding in this mysterious and ancient space. Every word seemed to contain endless power, causing the surrounding air to tremble slightly. His majestic voice carried an irresistible momentum, and he obviously wanted to expel the woman named Lisa in front of him from this place of inheritance.
Faced with the giant's rebuke, Lisa showed no intention of flinching. She raised her head, looked at the giant firmly, and responded: "Senior, I have no ill intentions in coming here. I just want to obtain the inheritance of the Human Emperor to protect the tranquility and peace of this world."
Hearing the words "Inheritance of the Human Emperor", the giant couldn't help but frowned and seemed to be lost in thought. After a while, he slowly spoke again and said: "The inheritance of the Human Emperor is not a simple thing! Even if I can feel a trace of the old friend's breath from you, at most it can only prevent you from being negatively affected in this place of inheritance."
After a moment of silence, the giant spoke again: "However, since you are so persistent in carrying out the inheritance of the Human Emperor, as the guardian of this inheritance land, I can naturally only follow the orders given to me by the master. But before that, you must successfully pass the three extremely difficult tests that await you next."
As the giant finished speaking, the originally calm space behind him suddenly glowed with a strange light, as if a stone had been thrown into the calm lake, causing ripples. Then, three huge portals appeared as if they were slowly emerging from the void, and each portal exuded a heart-stopping aura.
"These three gates respectively correspond to the three most important things in the world - love, wealth, and power." The giant's eyes swept over the three gates in turn and said slowly, "And among them, only one gate is the gate that can lead you to life. As for the other two, they are both gates of death."
Hearing this, Lisa took a deep breath, then resolutely walked forward. When she came not far from the door, she stopped involuntarily. Her eyes were firmly fixed on the door marked with the word "love", and she did not look away for a long time.
"If there was only one way to make a living, I think I would choose the door of love without hesitation. However, the meaning of the word 'love' is too broad. It covers family, friendship and love... Which emotion can lead me to the way of life?"
Dragon Kingdom Chapter 42 The Inheritance of the Human Emperor (3)
At this moment, a picture, like a sudden storm, once again swept through Lisa's ocean of thoughts.
Thirteen years ago…
"Lisa...Lisa..."
On this afternoon sun-dappled campus path, a hurried and expectant whisper broke the tranquility around her. Lisa suddenly turned back, her bright eyes sparkling with youthful sparks, which seemed to illuminate every inch of the surrounding area. At that time, Lisa was in the prime of her life, exuding vitality and vitality that could not be ignored. Just like every companion around her who had dreams, the years were passing by, but everyone's dreams were like gems carefully carved by time, lasting forever - to be admitted to the legendary Martial Arts Bureau and become the Martial God that everyone is looking for., step onto the battlefield, defend the home and country with passion, and guard every inch of peace on this land.
As the saying goes, men can make contributions and careers, and daughters can also stand alone, supporting half of the vast sky.
"What's wrong with you today? You're in a daze. Could it be that you were taken away by that stern old professor to clean the dusty library again?" Kana asked with a hint of teasing and concern, while gently leaning on Lisa's shoulder. The friendship between the two seemed particularly warm at this moment.
Lisa smiled slightly, and there was a bit of helplessness and relief hidden in that smile. She shook her head slightly, and her hair danced in the sunlight like golden ripples. "Yes, the old professor's 'special care' is always on time, but..." Lisa's words suddenly stopped, and a trace of unconcealable excitement flashed in her eyes, "But, at 4 o'clock this afternoon, there is news that may turn our world upside down!"
When Kana heard this, her eyes suddenly lit up, as if she had captured some crucial information. "Oh? What news?"
Lisa took a deep breath and lowered her voice, but could not hide the excitement in her tone: "Martial God Bureau, at 4 o'clock this afternoon, four SSS-level Martial Gods will visit our school in person! Their purpose of this trip is clear, to select 12 outstanding ones among us to form three teams for special training! Those are SSS-level Martial Gods, who are said to be able to single-handedly turn the tide of a war!"
